text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate (5.8%) and increased p99 latency for model family caspian-7b in eu-west-1. RPM up 1.3x over baseline, sustained for 6m. Paging eng-oncall.

oncall-rogers: Ack. I'm on it — paging SRE and runtime. @sre-lee @runtime-sam can you take a look?

runtime-sam: I'm pulling the last 30m traces. seeing KV cache evictions and GC churn on a few inference workers. memory pressure spikes right before the 5xx bursts.

sre-lee: Checked infra: node pool 3/12 had OOM killer events, one host rebooted by autoscaler, a couple longer-tail network retries. Not seeing backend datastore errors.

runtime-sam: workload tiling shows a lot of long-context requests for caspian-7b from a handful of tenants — token per request med is 2.2x normal. batching backpressure + cold KV = token latency.

oncall-rogers: Customer impact? any major tenants affected? @platform-ana @customer-success-maya

platform-ana: Top 5 tenants generating traffic on caspian-7b: team-alpha (high), partner-X (med), partner-Y (low). team-alpha has some production jobs that could hit rate limits.

customer-success-maya: Reaching out to team-alpha now to warn them about potential degraded responses. Will update within 10m.

runtime-sam: Proposing live mitigation: temporary per-model softcap and per-tenant carveout. Steps: 1) set caspian-7b region eu-west-1 TPM=600 (current ~1400) 2) disable function-calls for caspian-7b in that region (reduces multi-step calls) 3) enable prefix-KV sticky caching for known tenants.

sre-lee: +1 for softcap. disable-funcall might cause regressions but less costly than full OOM cascade. We can lift once KV pressure drops.

oncall-rogers: If everyone agrees I'll run the quota change. tagging @deploy-bot to apply the change and @runtime-sam to watch rolling metrics.

oncall-rogers: /infra/quotas adjust --model caspian-7b --region eu-west-1 --tpm 600 --reason "live mitigation: KV thrash / latency"

deploy-bot: QUEUED: quota-change job 98765 created by oncall-rogers. Applying to eu-west-1 replicas...

deploy-bot: DONE: quota-change applied. model=caspian-7b region=eu-west-1 new_tpm=600 job=98765 :white_check_mark:

runtime-sam: seeing immediate drop in request concurrency and median latency down ~30% in the first 90s. error rate trending down. 

sre-lee: host OOM events stopped on the previously noisy nodes. autoscaler no longer thrashing.

oncall-rogers: customer-success-maya any update from team-alpha?

customer-success-maya: team-alpha saw increased 5xx earlier but now reports degraded throughput but acceptable. They want a heads-up when we lift limits.

platform-ana: Note: some internal batched workflows may retry on failures. We should monitor retry storm. Consider short retry-window increase for affected customers.

runtime-sam: Agree. I'll also disable funcall for caspian-7b in eu-west-1 now: /runtime/feature-toggle set caspian-7b funcall false --region eu-west-1

deploy-bot: feature-toggle applied: caspian-7b funcall=false region=eu-west-1

oncall-rogers: Good. For the runbook: we'll keep TPM=600 for 30m, monitor p95/p99 and error rate. If stable after 30m, step to 900 TPM. If error rate climbs, tighten to 400.

sre-lee: Logging note: mark this period with an incident tag for postmortem. Also capturing tenant list for traffic shaping audit.

runtime-sam: Current numbers: p99 latency down from 2.1s -> 1.3s, error rate down from 5.8% -> 1.1% in eu-west-1 (5m windows).

oncall-rogers: Thanks everyone. @customer-success-maya keep the tenants informed, @platform-ana schedule a follow-up for 1h to decide on rollback. I'll file an incident ticket now.

customer-success-maya: pinged team-alpha, team says they'll pause heavy jobs for 30m and coordinate with us for traffic ramp. :thumbsup:

oncall-rogers: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-4721. Assigning to runtime-sam and sre-lee for investigation and postmortem.

runtime-sam: Logging follow-ups: regen KV tuning parameters, look into heuristics to detect long-context flooders, consider per-tenant early-shed policy.

sre-lee: I'll correlate autoscaler events and node metrics to see if capacity thresholds were mis-set.

oncall-rogers: Closing loop: leave thread open for updates, escalate to eng-leads if we need capacity increases.

deploy-bot: REMINDER: scheduled revert checks at +30m job=98765

oncall-rogers: last update: system stable, keeping TPM=600 for now. Will update at +30m.
